dialog.gone: That announcement has ended, so it can't be shown again.

operator.subtitle: Notices shown to people using this deployment. Each one is shown once and remembered per person.
operator.editorSubtitle: Give it a title, then add a section for each thing you want to show.
operator.deleteDescription: "{{title}}" will be removed, along with everyone's record of having read it.
operator.needsTitleAndSection: An announcement needs a title and at least one section

fields.title: Title
fields.minRoleHint: Only people at this rung or above are shown it.
fields.communityAdminsOnlyHint: Show it only to people who administer at least one community.
fields.expiresHint: Leave empty to keep showing it. An end date also takes it off the announcements page.
fields.altPlaceholder: Describe the image for screen readers
fields.draftPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep it a draft
fields.dismissalsRequiredHint: How many times someone has to dismiss it before it stops coming back. Keep it at 1 unless missing it would hurt.
fields.triggerRouteHint: Leave empty to show it right away. A path pattern holds it until someone opens a matching page — * is one part of the path, ** is the rest.

triggerErrors.needsSlash: Start the pattern with a / — for example /c/*/settings.
triggerErrors.whitespace: A path pattern can't contain spaces.
triggerErrors.wildcardSegment: * and ** stand for a whole part of the path, so they can't be joined to other characters.
triggerErrors.doubleStarNotLast: ** matches the rest of the path, so nothing can come after it.

accounts.existing: Accounts that existed when it was published
accounts.new: Accounts made since it was published

accountsHint.everyone: Anyone in the audience above is shown it.
accountsHint.existing: For a change people lived through — somebody who joined afterwards is not told.
accountsHint.new: For somebody just arriving — an onboarding tip, stale for everyone else.
